subject: English Home Language

source.subtopic: Uses present and past progressive tenses (He is reading; They were watching)

show.line: He is reading. It is happening right now. They were watching. That was happening before. Listen for ing!

rounds.prompt: Right now the girl ... Which words fit?
rounds.praise: Yes! Right now, she is skipping.

rounds.prompt: Yesterday the boys ... football. Which words fit?
I am ... a book. Read or reading? Say the right word.
Which sentence tells what is happening now?
rounds.praise: Yes! She is eating, right now.

rounds.prompt: Happening now, or happening before? Sort the cards.

rounds.text: The dogs were barking all night.
accept: the dogs were barking all night

rounds.prompt: Which word goes with they? They ... singing.

hints: Is and are mean now. Was and were mean before.
The verb ends with ing. Reading, watching, playing.

beat_the_tutor.setup: My turn! Yesterday the cats ... sleeping.
beat_the_tutor.win_line: You caught me! Yesterday, and more than one cat. The cats were sleeping.
beat_the_tutor.gentle_line: Let's say it together. Yesterday the cats were sleeping!

parent_line: Can use is, are, was and were with ing verbs, like he is reading.
